title: Number of Times Binary String Is Prefix-Aligned
summary: Given a binary string of length n with all bits initially set to 0, and an array of flips indicating which bits to flip at each step, count how many times the string is prefix-aligned after each flip.
statement: Given a binary string of length n with all bits initially set to 0, and an array of flips indicating which bits to flip at each step, count how many times the string is prefix-aligned after each flip.
constraints: flips is a permutation of positions 1..n turned on in order.
Count moments when every bit from one through the rightmost on bit is on.
reference_solution:
def prefix_aligned_moments(flips):
 maximum=answer=0
 for moment,position in enumerate(flips,1):maximum=max(maximum,position);answer+=maximum==moment
 return answer
hints: After moment m exactly m bits are on.
They form prefix 1..m exactly when the maximum flipped position so far equals m.
Track that maximum and count equal moments.
No holes can remain when m distinct on positions all lie within 1..m.
editorial: No holes can remain when m distinct on positions all lie within 1..m.

tests.explanation: Only moments four and five have an entirely on prefix.
All four bits align only at the final moment.
